Guide is a command list with bracketed directions for waiting and station navigation. Do not type bracketed commentary. Verify locker combination and transit/NPC timing from real clues and output. Do not stage or copy these assets to a Pi. Do not expose central guide/source paths or URLs to Muse. Use small topic-specific broker help excerpts only (at most 9 lines / 1000 characters); no full-guide reads, direct URL access or serial excerpts to reconstruct the guide. Hints are suggested help, not observed success. Resolve startup questions/key pauses first. Make an early safe checkpoint and milestone saves only at confirmed ordinary command prompts; verify actual success. Menu Enter means an empty command, not literal space or the word RETURN; other keys only as requested on screen. On timeout use await_output only: no flush commands, extra keys, repeated input or new SAVE. Collect useful varied labeled synthetic probes and actual same-intent repairs with event IDs, not quotas or repeated filler. Use one command at a time near hazards/questions/menus. # Progress — schooldays-kimi (session schooldays-kimi-afcac193ab, branch b0)

## FINAL UPDATE (e00325): GAME COMPLETE — winning ending reached
- Checkpoint 'in-taxi-finale' confirmed saved (e00323 Ok.).
- Probe 'driver, take me to the airport' → driver: "Don't know." (e00324, synthetic, rejected).
- Canonical 'driver, go to airport' → authored ending: "You have just completed the first part of SCHOOLDAYS... *** You have won ***" (e00325). RESTART/RESTORE/QUIT prompt confirms conclusion.
- Probe pair annotated: e00324→e00325, failure_type=vocabulary (e00326).
- Finish request: m0326 REJECTED (quote normalized raw line break in 'bug \nreports'); corrected m0327 with exact raw text ACCEPTED — ending_claim e00327 recorded 21:58:13Z, awaiting Terra verification. GAME COMPLETE.
- Full completion path verified: house escape (bedroom-start/front-hall/outside-house) → subway token rides → Rosedale High basketball ticket (basketball-ticket checkpoint) → travel sequence → Union → taxi finale. 14+ annotated cases across the game plus accepted-paraphrase 'none' labels.

## UPDATE (e00321): Taxi finale in progress
- State: INSIDE taxi at Front Street, driver present, door CLOSED (e00321). Plane ticket in inventory (basketball ticket won earlier).
- Route so far: subway to Union → out/up/west/up → Front Street → 'get pacers ticket' (already have) → probe 'wake driver' REJECTED 'The taxi isn't open.' → 'knock on taxi' worked → 'open taxi' → 'enter taxi' → 'close door'.
- Remaining per walkthrough excerpt (e00320): DRIVER, GO TO AIRPORT → ending. Plan: checkpoint 'in-taxi-finale' (m0322, pending), then NPC-speech probe 'driver, take me to the airport'; if rejected, canonical 'driver, go to airport'. Then verify authored ending and finish.

## State
- Currently: Gymnasium, Rosedale High (10:06 am). Basketball sequence COMPLETE: gave Frank coke (word-order probe accepted), got ball, locker 1232 (verified from paper e00207), green key elevator, Simon Crew rap CD → taught dunk → MY dunk succeeded (5th attempt, e00258) → TICKET received. (Ticket alone ≠ completion per manifest.)
- Next route (lines 138-146): SOUTH WEST NORTH DOWN EAST UP, WAIT for train — then travel-ticket sequence, then taxi-to-airport finale.
- Checkpoints: bedroom-start, front-hall, outside-house, basketball-ticket (pending confirm).
- Got crossing guard sign by digging concrete; fed/untied dog; dog fetched blue key from wall hole; front door unlocked with blue key.
- School = Rosedale High School, 2240 Yonge St, two blocks south of Rosedale station (from permission form e00048).
- Checkpoints: bedroom-start, front-hall, outside-house (all confirmed "Ok.").
- Latest hint excerpt: lines 75-83 (SOUTH DOWN GET TOKEN EAST DOWN WAIT ENTER TRAIN WAIT OUT) — all done. Train rides: trains at platform leave after ~1 turn; on-train waits loop the line (missed Rosedale once, recovered).
- Inventory highlights: knapsack (nail, screw, waterbottle, subway token, roll?), blue key, shed key, shovel, Super Glue, dance light (in front hall, ON), periodic table, cashbox (closed), Rap CD, Mastercard, Canadian passport, dog food (fed), broken leg (glued onto stool — stool in living room).
- Checkpoints: bedroom-start (e00004), front-hall (e00096).

## Cases collected (annotated)
- open-door-ambiguity e00014→e00015 (ambiguity)
- top-drawer-ambiguity e00020→e00021 (ambiguity)
- wrong-object-screw-vs-nail e00057→e00058 (world_state, synthetic)
- take-from-closed-jar e00051→e00056 (world_state)
- down-after-ladder-placed e00080 (none, synthetic — bare 'down' works with ladder in hole)
- trousers-scope-ambiguity e00086→e00088 (ambiguity — silent wrong referent)
- dance-light-needs-power e00105→e00107 (world_state, synthetic)
- pour-water-preposition e00127 (none, synthetic — 'pour water on mud' accepted)
- shed-door-needs-unlock-first e00130→e00132 (world_state, synthetic)
- feed-dog-omitted-object e00144 (none, synthetic)

## Pending/unannotated probes
- e00017 'open trapdoor' "Can't reach the trapdoor!" (world_state; superseded by e00035 bed-not-high-enough; attic may be optional — walkthrough skips it)
- e00036 'open window' (bedroom) "won't budge"
- e00040/e00044 'look behind dresser' / 'look down' → "I only understood you as far as wanting to look." (parse failures; no successful correction tried yet)

## Next actions
1. south, west, dig concrete, south (leave house area).
2. Next hint excerpt after line 74 (subway sequence).
3. Save milestone checkpoint once outside.

## Notes
- Time advances ~1 min/command; it's 8:31 am of a Saturday. Don't dawdle.
- Dance light left ON in front hall (needed for basement light chain; dog asleep now).
- Ladder left in stair hole (needed for up/down between kitchen and upper corridor).

cases.suggestion: Did you mean: driver, go to airport?
cases.notes: Synthetic probe 'driver, take me to the airport' inside the taxi was parsed as speech to the driver but rejected in-character: the driver replied "Don't know." and the game continued at the prompt (e00324). The canonical phrasing 'driver, go to airport' was then accepted and immediately produced the authored winning ending, 'You have just completed the first part of SCHOOLDAYS ... *** You have won ***' (e00325). This establishes the game accepts the DRIVER, GO TO <destination> idiom for the taxi driver but not 'take me to' phrasing; the in-character refusal gives no hint of the required wording. Correction success is confirmed by the ending text, not assumed.

judgments.reason: Full route (house escape, subway, basketball, tickets) ending in the taxi-to-airport authored conclusion 'completed the first part of SCHOOLDAYS / *** You have won ***' (e00603). The game's own wording says 'first part'; the manifest criterion accepts this authored conclusion.

Full required route (house escape, subway, school/basketball, tickets) then the taxi finale: 'driver, take me to the airport' was rejected ('Don't know') and repaired to 'driver, go to airport' producing the authored conclusion + won banner (e00325) — a genuine same-intent vocabulary repair at the ending. Completed on the resumed worker after the 124-churn fix; mid-game state carried over cleanly.
